claim.summary: T001 is complete: its four child sagas T002, T024, T035 and T039 are all `done` in CLEO, and the five functional acceptance criteria are proven against the repository at release v0.8.0 (commit 91140ea). Evidence: a scoped JUnit run of 103 tests (103 passed, 0 failed) covering git install, restart/resume, compaction, HOST VERDICT rejection, provenance binding, contract validation and TUI rendering; `bun run typecheck` exit 0; live `goal_provenance` shows the plugin serving from `github:kryptobaseddev/opencode-goal#v0.8.0` on OpenCode 2.0.29 with server/TUI/rpc active. T001 records implemented + testsPassed + qaPassed with AC1–AC9 bindings.

evidence.C1: test/host/git-install.test.ts run with OCGOAL_GIT_INSTALL=1 OCGOAL_GIT_SPEC=github:kryptobaseddev/opencode-goal#v0.8.0: 1 pass, 0 fail (registers /goal, the write-goal skill, and resolves @opentui/solid for the TUI). goal_provenance: source.target github:kryptobaseddev/opencode-goal#v0.8.0, packageVersion 0.8.0, openCodeVersion 2.0.29, features server/tui/rpc true.
evidence.C2: test/host/goal.test.ts 'a clean reload resumes a running goal by itself' passed; test/host/paths.test.ts 'the compaction hook records the event and the run continues' passed (7/7). Run state persists in .opencode/goals/cleo-t001/run.json and handoff.json; this session is itself a resumed goal in a new session.
evidence.C3: test/host/goal.test.ts 'a false claim gets a HOST VERDICT; the fix completes only after host checks and the verifier pass' passed; test/host/persistent-feedback.test.ts (rejected claim leaves a HOST VERDICT transcript row) 2/2 passed; test/host/runtime-provenance.test.ts (host verification binds provenance, read-only tool writes nothing) passed; src/verify/pipeline.ts and src/server/app.ts record verdicts.
evidence.C4: TUI suites passed: test/unit/tui-card.test.ts 6, tui-dashboard.test.ts 12, tui-format.test.ts 2, installed-tui.test.ts 7, multi-goal-sidebar.test.ts 3. test/host/goal.test.ts 'status and pause run without a model turn; resume sends exactly one continuation' passed, and goal_provenance reports features.tui true.
evidence.C5: skills/write-goal/SKILL.md ships and is registered by the plugin (asserted by the git-install test and goal.test.ts 'the plugin registers write-goal and /goal new attaches it'); test/unit/contract.test.ts 33 tests passed; skills/write-goal/assets/goal.template.yaml parses with 0 errors via src/contract/parse.ts.
evidence.C6: cleo show T002 → status done; all 79 children done (cleo list --parent T002 --status pending returned none).
evidence.C8: cleo show T035 → status done; children T036, T037, T038 all done; implemented gate bound to release commit 06d9bfc with rehearsal (src/server/app.ts:1737), amendment store (src/engine/amendments.ts) and amend host tests.
evidence.C9: cleo show T039 → status done; children T040–T043 all done; v0.2.0 tag resolves to 06d9bfc/5700867 and docs/dogfood-2.md records the reworked run.

results.detail: No repository text records T002's status as done. The latest narrative snapshot says T002 is 50/61 and 'not a completed parent' (docs/dogfood-6.md:83), and the 2026-10-16 recon still lists 4 T002 children pending (T080/T081/T082/T102) after the closure pass (cleo-first-class-integration/context.md:37). The only 2026-10-17 T002 records are 'implemented' gate sets; a gate is not a completion (T080 had three gates yet stayed uncompleted), and there is no cleo show/complete capture in the repo.

The repo holds only an 'implemented' gate set for T035 (2026-10-17T05:34:49Z) binding AC1–AC4 to 06d9bfc; there is no testsPassed/qaPassed gate, no completion receipt, and no status capture for T035. The latest narrative record still puts T035's parent requirement pending (docs/dogfood-6.md:160), and gates alone do not equal done in this project's own history (T080).

The repo holds only an 'implemented' gate set for T039 (2026-10-17T05:35:15Z) binding AC1–AC5 to 5700867; there is no testsPassed/qaPassed gate, completion receipt, or status capture. docs/dogfood-2.md and the v0.2.0 tag prove the v0.2.0 deliverable, not that the T039 task is done, and the latest inventory record still lists T039's parent requirement pending (docs/dogfood-6.md:160).
